text: Today we finish chapter four with the divergence theorem. Look at the boundary of R, a closed, piecewise smooth surface, and the outward unit normal n.
This theorem will be on the midterm. Know both sides by heart. The normal always points outward; if you flip it, the flux changes sign.
Think of div F as how fast a tiny fluid element around X expands. Total outflow through the boundary equals total expansion inside.
Example one. F is (x, y, z) on the unit ball. The divergence is three, so the flux is three times the volume, four pi. Check it in polar coordinates too.
